findings.current: It felt as though she had grown another step while facing the difficult choices between the threat of her sect’s destruction and swearing loyalty to another family.
findings.defect: The draft presents the threat of the sect’s destruction as one of two choices available to Lee Seowol. The source instead pairs that crisis with her difficult decision to swear loyalty.
findings.rationale: The threat of annihilation is a circumstance she faced, not an option she could choose.
findings.replacement: It felt as though she had grown another step through the crisis that threatened to destroy her sect and the difficult decision to swear loyalty.
findings.source: 멸문의 위기와 충성 맹세라는 쉽지 않은 선택의 기로에서 한 단계 성장한 느낌이랄까.

findings.current: He glared at me with blazing eyes, then let out deep sighs every time he exchanged a few words with Lee Seowol.
findings.defect: The draft makes Chulwoo the person exchanging words with Lee Seowol. In context, Chulwoo is glaring and sighing whenever Taekyung and Lee Seowol talk.
findings.rationale: The omitted subject is Taekyung, as established by Chulwoo’s jealousy and his glare toward the narrator.
findings.replacement: He glared at me with blazing eyes, then let out a deep sigh every time Lee Seowol and I exchanged a few words.
findings.source: 이글거리는 눈빛으로 나를 노려보다가 이소월과 사소한 대화를 주고받을 때마다 한숨을 푹푹 내쉰다.

findings.current: After reaching the Peak realm, I had gained the ability to use Sound Transmission, but it was something I could acquire through practice. That didn’t mean I could use it right away.
findings.defect: The first sentence says Taekyung already gained the ability to use Sound Transmission, contradicting the source’s explanation that reaching Peak merely made the skill learnable through practice.
findings.rationale: The source distinguishes meeting the realm prerequisite from actually acquiring and using the skill.
findings.replacement: Reaching the Peak realm had made Sound Transmission available for me to learn through practice; it hadn’t granted me the skill on the spot.
findings.source: 절정의 경지에 오르며 [전음]을 사용할 수 있게 됐지만 연습을 통해 습득 가능하다는 것이었지, 바로 쓸 수 있게 된 것은 아니었다.

findings.current: “My junior disciples and I would be happy to accept.”
findings.defect: The draft changes Baek Museong’s junior brothers into his disciples, altering their sect hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 사제 denotes Baek Museong’s junior brothers within Huashan, not disciples under his instruction.
findings.replacement: “My junior brothers and I would be happy to accept.”

findings.current: “Of course. On such a fine day, I can only be grateful for the opportunity to entertain our guests.”
findings.defect: The draft casts Baek Museong as a host entertaining other guests, while he explicitly speaks of contributing to the festivities in his own capacity as a guest.
findings.rationale: 객으로서 identifies Baek Museong himself as the guest.
findings.replacement: “Of course. On such a fine day, I am simply grateful for the opportunity to help enliven the festivities as a guest.”
findings.source: 물론입니다. 이 좋은 날에 객으로서 흥을 돋울 기회를 주셔서 감사할 따름이지요.

findings.current: His gloomy, tear-damp eyes turned toward Choo Dohwan.
findings.defect: The draft adds physical tears that are absent from the source. His eyes are figuratively steeped in gloom, not wet from crying.
findings.rationale: 젖은 modifies his eyes figuratively through 음울하게 and conveys pervasive gloom rather than tearfulness.
findings.replacement: His eyes, steeped in gloom, turned toward Choo Dohwan.

findings.current: There were no forms or techniques worth mentioning.
findings.defect: The qualifier “worth mentioning” implies that forms or techniques may have been used but were unimpressive. The source says there were none at all.
findings.rationale: The sentence establishes that the fight has abandoned technique entirely.
findings.replacement: There were no forms or techniques at all.

findings.current: “The Iron Fist Choo Dohwan is a fairly well-known master, but he couldn’t stand up to Huashan’s Three Plum Blossom Elites.”
findings.defect: The plural construction makes it sound as though Choo Dohwan fought all three elites, when he fought Chulwoo alone, who is one member of that group.
findings.rationale: The collective title identifies Chulwoo’s status; it does not add the other two elites to the fight.
findings.replacement: “The Iron Fist Choo Dohwan is a fairly well-known master, but he’s no match for one of Huashan’s Three Plum Blossom Elites.”
findings.source: 철권 추도환이면 나름 알아주는 고수인데, 화산파 매화삼절에게는 안 되는구나.

findings.current: After knocking down fifteen-odd people in the span of roughly two hours, Chulwoo let out a roar.
findings.defect: The draft substantially inflates the elapsed time. 한 식경 is approximately the time needed to eat a meal, conventionally around half an hour, not two hours.
findings.rationale: The short duration underscores how rapidly Chulwoo disposed of the challengers.
findings.replacement: After knocking down fifteen-odd people in about the time it took to eat a meal, Chulwoo let out a roar.
findings.source: 약 한 식경 만에 열댓 명을 쓰러트린 철우가 포효했다.

findings.current: > - **Quest:** **There Was a Man Who Loved You Too Much** has been created.
findings.defect: The title changes both the present existence of the man into the past and “so much” into the more judgmental “too much.”
findings.rationale: 있어 is present-tense existence, while 너무 사랑한 expresses how greatly he loved the addressee rather than explicitly judging it as excessive.
findings.replacement: > - **Quest:** **There Is a Man Who Loved You So Much** has been created.
findings.source: - [한 남자가 있어, 널 너무 사랑한] 퀘스트가 생성되었습니다.

findings.current: She was still young, and the proposal had been little different from an offer of a political marriage, but I couldn’t help feeling strangely about it.
findings.defect: “Still young” softens Taekyung’s more dismissive description of Lee Seowol as still being a kid.
findings.rationale: 어린애 conveys his explicit perception of her as a child, which matters to his discomfort about the proposal.
findings.replacement: She was still just a kid, and the proposal had been little different from an offer of a political marriage, but I couldn’t help feeling strangely about it.
findings.source: 아직 어린애인 데다 정략혼 제의나 다름없지만, 기분이 묘해지는 건 어쩔 수 없다.

findings.current: She added another word with a faint smile.
findings.defect: The draft makes this smile faint, flattening the distinction from the explicitly faint smile she gives shortly afterward, and “added another word” is unnatural English.
findings.rationale: 싱긋 is a small, pleasant smile, while the later 희미하게 웃음 is the genuinely faint smile.
findings.replacement: With a light smile, she added,

findings.current: *They ought to be banging their heads against the ground, and it still wouldn’t be enough.*
findings.defect: The draft turns a crude image of keeping their heads planted in submission into repeatedly striking their heads against the ground.
findings.rationale: 대가리 박고 있어 conveys a sustained, humiliating posture of submission, while 놈들이 supplies the narrator’s contemptuous register.
findings.replacement: *Those bastards should be down on their knees with their heads to the floor, and even that wouldn’t be enough.*

findings.current: The fabric of space-time seemed to crumple.
findings.defect: The draft loses the joke that Chulwoo’s performance is so embarrassing that space-time itself cringes.
findings.rationale: 오그라들다 here invokes secondhand embarrassment rather than literal crumpling.

findings.current: The Sect Leaders of the Five Gates of Shanxi, who were staring this way with faces as tense as if their lives depended on it, would surely be the highlight of the final day.
findings.defect: The draft preserves their anxiety but loses the narrator’s crude comic idiom.
findings.rationale: 똥줄 타다 is a deliberately coarse expression for extreme, increasingly desperate anxiety.
findings.replacement: The Sect Leaders of the Five Gates of Shanxi, who were staring this way as if someone had lit a fire under their asses, would surely be the highlight of the final day.
findings.source: 특히나 저 아래에서 똥줄 타는 얼굴로 이쪽을 바라보는 산서오문의 문주들은 마지막 날의 하이라이트가 될 게 분명했다.

findings.current: The gap in ability was so enormous that the other martial artists were now visibly tired of watching.
findings.defect: The draft makes the spectators bored with watching, while the source indicates that Chulwoo’s overwhelming superiority has left them daunted or sickened enough to lose their appetite for challenging him.
findings.rationale: 질려 하는 describes being put off or intimidated by the repeated overwhelming defeats, not simple boredom.
findings.replacement: The gap in ability was so enormous that the other martial artists now looked thoroughly daunted.
findings.source: 워낙 수준 차이가 심하다 보니 이제는 다른 무인들도 질려 하는 기색이 역력했다.

summary: The draft contains two critical factual errors involving who speaks with Lee Seowol and the duration of Chulwoo’s duels, along with several major hierarchy, mechanism, action, and characterization errors.
